title: Vaga para Marine Supervisor
description:
MARINE TECHNICIAN

Departamento: Marine Operations
Reporta a: Marine Supervisor
Localização: Angola
Regime de trabalho: Rotação de 28:28 dias

Job Summary

Responsible for supporting the delivery of safe, optimal and environmentally sound operations, using basic technical and analytical capabilities to improve operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safe and Reliable Marine Operations
  • Marine Systems Maintenance
  • Safety and Risk Management
  • Control of Work (CoW)
  • Operational Support and Troubleshooting
  • Marine Operations Execution
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Competency Development
  • Communication and Teamwork

Qualifications & Experience

  • Engineer Certificate of Competency and/or Degree in Engineering or related discipline.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent, or as required by local requirements.
  • STCW Basic Safety Training.
  • At least 5-year experience in offshore marine operations, tanker operations, or similar high-hazard environments.

Requirements

  • Working knowledge of ballast systems, cargo handling, and marine utilities, with a willingness to build deeper technical expertise.
  • Troubleshooting and maintaining marine systems, with a strong desire to develop further.
  • Experience in offshore marine operations, tanker operations, or similar high-hazard environments.
  • Comfortable working in an environment that values open reporting, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong team player who contributes to a positive, performance-driven culture offshore.
  • Open to and engaged with digital tools, data, and modern ways of working (e.g., digital rounds, CoW, system tracking).
  • Fluent English Speaker.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume/CV in English using the subject title “MARINE TECHNICIAN”.

Email: recrutamentovoefx@gmail.com

Additional Information

  • Only pre-selected candidates will be contacted.
  • Thank you to all applicants for your interest.
Passos para se inscrever:

Faça a sua candidatura através do e-mail: recrutamentovoefx@gmail.com

Partilhar: Verifique o seu CV

Carregue o seu CV e veja como ele se compara com esta vaga. É gratuito, não precisa de conta e o ficheiro não é guardado.

Arraste o seu CV para aqui ou clique para escolher no computador Verificar compatibilidade Compatibilidade com esta vaga —

Isto é uma orientação automática, não uma decisão. Quem escolhe os candidatos é a empresa.

Verificar outro CV

O ficheiro é usado só para esta verificação e não fica guardado em lado nenhum.
